about.title: Expertise for your peace of mind
paragraphs: Benjamin Auto Mechanic is a family-owned auto repair shop where honesty, integrity, and good business are as important to us as to our customers. We hold our work to the highest standard in the automotive industry.

We have been serving the Hillsboro area for more than 20 years. Our affordable service and customer satisfaction have expanded our customer base to Beaverton, Portland, Tigard, Sherwood, Forest Grove and Cornelius.
Expertise for your peace of mind: you can rest assured that you and your car will be well cared for, at our shop and once you're back on the road.
about.photo_alt: Mechanic going over a repair with a customer

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we'll get back to you. Or call or text (503) 421-0510 or (503) 648-9881, or email benauto2002@gmail.com to schedule your appointment.
estimate.thanks: Thanks! We will get back to you soon to set up a time.
